description: This file defines functions and classes related to data parallelism in PyTorch's neural network module, including module replication, gradient edge setup, and parallel execution across multiple devices.

classes.name: ReduceAdd
classes.description: Autograd function for summing tensors across devices during backward pass in data parallelism.

methods.name: replicate_grad_edges
methods.description: Recursively sets gradient edges from module parameters and buffers to their replicas.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Creates deep copies (clones) of a module across multiple devices and sets up gradient edges.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Overloaded version that works with ModuleHolder, replicating modules on multiple devices.

methods.name: parallel_apply
methods.description: Runs multiple modules in parallel on their respective inputs, handling exceptions.

methods.name: data_parallel
methods.description: Performs data parallelism by scattering input, replicating model, running in parallel, and gathering outputs.
